dataset_metadata.disclaimer: New AI-generated English drafts of the recorded Classical Chinese; not scholarly reviewed. Original source interpretations are not verified geometry or modern etymology.

shuowen:6501.text: Fire moving in faint flickering flames. Formed from 炎, with 臽 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6502.text: Firelight. Formed from 炎, with 舌 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6503.text: Encroaching fire. Formed from 炎, with 㐭 indicating the sound. Read like 葚 in 桑葚.

shuowen:6504.text: Fire moving or spreading. Formed from 炎, with 占 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6505.text: To scald meat in hot water. Formed from 炎 and abbreviated 熱.

shuowen:6506.text: Thoroughly cooked. Formed from 又 holding 炎 and 辛. 辛 is the flavor of cooked things.

shuowen:6507.text: The blood of those killed in battle and of cattle and horses becomes 粦, ghost-fire. Formed from 炎 and 舛.

shuowen:6508.text: The color left by fire's smoke. Formed from 炎 emerging upward through 𡆧. 𡆧 is the ancient character for window. All characters in this group are formed from 黑.

shuowen:6509.text: In Qi, black is called 黸. Formed from 黑, with 盧 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6510.text: A glossy or deep black color, perhaps, as expressed by 沃黑. Formed from 黑, with 會 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6511.text: Deep black. Formed from 黑, with 音 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6512.text: Extended blackness, according to the recorded 申黑 gloss; the precise sense is uncertain. Formed from 黑, with 厭 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6513.text: A small black spot or mole. Formed from 黑, with 殹 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6514.text: White with black in it. Formed from 黑, with 旦 indicating the sound. There is a 莫䵣 county in 五原.

shuowen:6515.text: Although fair, also dark. Formed from 黑, with 箴 indicating the sound. An ancient person named 𪒹 had the courtesy name 皙, 'fair.'

shuowen:6516.text: Red-black. Formed from 黑, with 昜 indicating the sound. Read like 煬.

shuowen:6517.text: Pale blue-black. Formed from 黑, with 參 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6518.text: Blue-black. Formed from 黑, with 奄 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6519.text: A slightly blue-black color. Formed from 黑, with 幼 indicating the sound. The Erya says: 'The ground is called 黝.'

shuowen:6520.text: A turbid yellow-black. Formed from 黑, with 屯 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6521.text: A small black spot. Formed from 黑, with 占 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6522.text: Pale yellow-black. Formed from 黑, with 甘 indicating the sound. Read like 黚 in the obscure dyeing phrase 染繒中束緅黚.

shuowen:6523.text: Yellow-black. Formed from 黑, with 金 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6524.text: Black with markings. Formed from 黑, with 冤 indicating the sound. Read like the character 𧯡 in 飴𧯡; the reference is obscure.

shuowen:6525.text: Yellow-black and white. Formed from 黑, with 算 indicating the sound. Alternatively, short and black. Read like 荃, the name for mustard made into a relish.

shuowen:6526.text: Black and chapped. Formed from 黑, with 幵 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6527.text: Firmly black. Formed from 黑, with 吉 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6528.text: Dark. Formed from 黑, with 今 indicating the sound. Qin called the people 黔首, meaning black-headed; Zhou called them 黎民. The Changes says: 'It has a black beak.'

shuowen:6529.text: Sediment and grime. Formed from 黑, with 冘 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6530.text: Not bright or fresh. Formed from 黑, with 尚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6531.text: To grasp and hold filth. Formed from 黑, with 賣 indicating the sound. The Changes says: 'Repeatedly, a second and third time, is profanation.'

shuowen:6532.text: Greatly stained. Formed from 黑, with 詹 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6533.text: Blue-black from prolonged rain. Formed from 黑, with abbreviated 微 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6534.text: To demote. Formed from 黑, with 出 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6535.text: 𪒀𡜜 means to smile downward or derisively, perhaps. Formed from 黑, with 般 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6536.text: To draw the eyebrows. Formed from 黑, with 朕 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6537.text: White stitching in blue-black silk fabric. Formed from 黑, with 攸 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6538.text: The seams of a lambskin robe. Formed from 黑, with 或 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6539.text: The source says 𪑍 is called 垽; 垽 means sediment. Formed from 黑, with abbreviated 殿 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6540.text: The blackness of mulberries. Formed from 黑, with 甚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6541.text: Fruit being dark and black. Formed from 黑, with 弇 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6542.text: The ink-tattoo punishment on the face. Formed from 黑, with 京 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6543.text: To forget and rest. Formed from 黑, with 敢 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6544.text: Black wood. Formed from 黑, with 多 indicating the sound. There is a 黟 county in 丹陽.

shuowen:6545.text: In a wall it is called 牖; in a roof, 囪. A pictograph. All characters in this group are formed from 囪.

shuowen:6546.text: Much hurried activity. Formed from 心 and 囪; 囪 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:6547.text: The blossom or brilliance of fire. Formed from three 火. All characters in this group are formed from 焱.

shuowen:6548.text: The light of lamps and torches beneath a roof. Formed from 焱 and 冂.

shuowen:6549.text: An abundant appearance. Formed from 焱 above 木. Read like 莘 in the Odes' 'Numerous marching men.' Alternatively, labor service.

shuowen:6550.text: To roast meat. Formed from 肉 above 火. All characters in this group are formed from 炙.

shuowen:6551.text: Meat cooked by fire for the ancestral temple. Formed from 炙, with 番 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'When the Son of Heaven has a ceremony, he roasts meat to send to feudal lords of the same surname.'

shuowen:6552.text: To roast. Formed from 炙, with 尞 indicating the sound. Read like 燎 in 𤒅燎.

shuowen:6553.text: The color of the south. Formed from 大 and 火. All characters in this group are formed from 赤.

shuowen:6554.text: Red. Formed from 赤, with abbreviated 蟲 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6555.text: The red of sunrise. Formed from 赤, with abbreviated 穀 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6556.text: The face reddening with shame. Formed from 赤, with 𠬝 indicating the sound. Zhou lost the realm under King Nan.

shuowen:6557.text: Red. Formed from 赤, with 坙 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'The fang fish has a red tail.'

shuowen:6558.text: Red, 䞓; the juice of 棠 and jujube fruits. An alternative form uses 水.

shuowen:6559.text: Red earth. Formed from 赤, with 者 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6560.text: Red. Formed from 赤, with 倝 indicating the sound. Read like 浣.

shuowen:6561.text: Fire's red appearance. Formed from two 赤.

shuowen:6562.text: Deep red. Formed from 赤 and 色; 色 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:6563.text: Red. Formed from 赤, with 叚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6564.text: Heaven is great, earth is great, and people too are great; hence 大 depicts a person. The source records ancient-script 大 with the fanqie reading 他達. All characters in this group are formed from 大.

shuowen:6565.text: The space between the thighs. Formed from 大, with 圭 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6566.text: To hold. Formed from 大 flanked by two 人, people.

shuowen:6567.text: To cover; having a great surplus. Also, lacking. Formed from 大 and 申. 申 means to extend.

shuowen:6568.text: Extravagant or expansive. Formed from 大, with 于 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6569.text: The extravagance expressed by 奢𡘍. Formed from 大, with 亘 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6570.text: 𡗷 means great. Formed from 大, with 瓜 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6571.text: Vast and empty. Formed from 大, with 歲 indicating the sound. Read like 泧 in the Odes' 'Set the nets across the flow.'

shuowen:6572.text: Great. Formed from 大, with 𢧄 indicating the sound. Read like 𢧜 in the Odes' 'Great and ample are the plans.'

shuowen:6573.text: Great. Formed from 大, with 卯 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6574.text: Great. Formed from 大, with 云 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6575.text: Great. Formed from 大, with 氐 indicating the sound. Read like 氐.

shuowen:6576.text: Great. Formed from 大, with 介 indicating the sound. Read like 蓋.

shuowen:6577.text: Eyes wide with anger, according to the recorded 瞋大 gloss. Formed from 大, with 此 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6578.text: Great. Formed from 大, with 弗 indicating the sound. Read like 弼 in 'When I err, you assist me.'

shuowen:6579.text: Great. Formed from 大, with 屯 indicating the sound. Read like 鶉.

shuowen:6580.text: A great agreement or covenant. Formed from 大 and 㓞. The Changes says: 'Sages of later ages changed this to written contracts.'

shuowen:6581.text: Level. Formed from 大 and 弓. Also, people of the east.

shuowen:6582.text: A person's armpits. Formed from 大, depicting the two armpits. All characters in this group are formed from 亦.

shuowen:6583.text: To steal and conceal something against the body. Formed from 亦 holding something. The popular expression for concealing it from others by tucking it at one's side refers to this. 陝 in 弘農 is formed from this.

shuowen:6584.text: To tilt the head. Formed from 大; a pictograph. All characters in this group are formed from 夨.

shuowen:6585.text: The head tilting. Formed from 夨, with 吉 indicating the sound. Read like 孑.

shuowen:6586.text: The head slanted, with a crooked bearing. Formed from 夨, with 圭 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6587.text: A surname; also, a commandery. Alternatively, 吳 means loud speech. Formed from 夨 and 口.

shuowen:6588.text: Bent. Formed from 大; a pictograph. All characters in this group are formed from 夭.

shuowen:6589.text: High and curved. Formed from 夭 and abbreviated 高. The Odes says: 'In the south are tall trees.'

shuowen:6590.text: Fortunate and escaping misfortune. Formed from 屰 and 夭. 夭 concerns death; thus death is called 'not 𡴘,' unfortunate.

shuowen:6591.text: To run. Formed from 夭, with abbreviated 賁 indicating the sound. It shares the conception of 走, both being formed from 夭.

shuowen:6592.text: Crossed shins. Formed from 大, depicting crossing. All characters in this group are formed from 交.

shuowen:6593.text: Slanting. Formed from 交, with 韋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6594.text: To hang by the neck. Formed from 交 and 糸.

shuowen:6595.text: Lame, with bent shins. Formed from 大, depicting a one-sided bend. All characters in the 𡯂 group are formed from 𡯂.

shuowen:6596.text: A knee ailment. Formed from 尣 and 骨; 骨 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:6597.text: Lame. Formed from 𡯂, with 皮 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6598.text: 𡯛𡯛 means walking unevenly. Formed from 𡯂, with 左 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6599.text: To walk unevenly. Formed from 𡯂, with 艮 indicating the sound. Read like 燿.

shuowen:6600.text: Not straight or proper. Formed from 尣, with 兼 indicating the sound.
